tei:div.tei:p: 461)༄༅/ phur sgrub bdud las rnam rgyal gyi 'don 'grigs theg chen lam 'jug bzhugs so/ 462) bla ma dang gnyis su med pa dpal chen badzra ku mā ra la phyag 'tshal lo/ de la 'dir phur sgrub zab mo bdud las rnam rgyal gyi sgo nas gtor bzlog bya ba la/ bshams bkod kyi rim pa rnams phyag bzhes ltar grub rjes/ thog mar/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ma lus sems can sogs/ gshegs su gsol/ a sarba ta thā ga tā sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ padma ka ma la ye st+waṃḥ hūm̐ hrīḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i sogs/ oṃ sa rba ma hā gu ru bidyā dha ra badzra sa ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ padma kā ma la ye st+waṃḥ gnas mchog 'di ru sogs/ bcom ldan 'dir ni sogs/ 'dir ni gzugs sogs/ sa gzhi spos sogs/ sku gsum yongs rdzogs sogs/ bla ma sku khams sogs/ e ma hoḥ spros bral sogs/ e ma hoḥ nub phyogs bde ba sogs/ e ma hoḥ rgyal kun sogs/ mtsho dbus sogs/ o rgyan rin po che la sogs lan gsum/ hrī: dkon mchog skyabs gnas/ 463)e ma ho: khyab bdag gdod ma'i sogs/ e ma ho: bde gshegs snying po'i sogs/ e ma ho: gzhi dbyings thog sogs/ e ma ho: chos dbyings 'dus ma sogs/ skye ba kun tu sogs/ spyi gces sngon 'gro la/ rang nyid skad cig sogs/ hriṃ hriṃ dza dzaḥ spro na nyin dang po phur ba bder snying gi lhan thabs ltar bya/ mchan/ cho ga spyi'i mtshams sbyar ltar byed tshe/ bsang chu byin brlab ni/ oṃ swa bha wa sogs/ stong pa nyid du gyur sogs/ bsam: oṃ badzra a mṛ ta sogs/ nyer gcig gam bdun/ lha de nyid 'od du sogs/ ṇa hūm̐: mchod rdzas byin brlabs ni/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta sogs/ ya hoḥ spos phyung la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: ngo bo sku sogs/ ye hūm̐: phur sgrub gsol 'debs las/ e ma hoḥ kun bzang sogs/ spro na nyin dang po lhan thabs las rdor dril/ ḍā ru rnga rol byin brlabs bya/ mchan/

mtshams sbyar las/ skyabs yul bskyed/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ye ta sogs/ bstim mo: sgrub gzhung las/ skyabs sems/ na mo: bla med bla ma sogs/ lan gsum dang*/ hoḥ ma gyur mkha' 464)mnyam sogs/ yan bdun/ na mo: dpal chen lha tshogs sogs/ mtshams sbyar las/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing sogs/ gyur: spro na nyin dang po sngon 'gro bgegs sel ltar bya/ mchan/ nyin phyi ma rnams su dkar gtor byin brlab/ oṃ swa bha wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang sogs/ oṃ a ka ro sogs dang nam mkha' mdzod sngags/ dkar gtor las/ hūm̐: mchod sbyin sogs/ khā hiḥ na mo/ bdag gi bsam pa'i sogs/ 'byung gyur cig mtshams lha la/ oṃ hrī padma kro dha= sha ya hūm̐: mtshams sbyar las bgegs gtor byin brlabs/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta sogs/ oṃ swa bha wa sogs/ gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ lan gsum/ ha ho hrīḥ oṃ sarba bhū ta sogs/ lan gsum/ sam bha ra lan gsum/ gzhung gi bka' bsgo ba/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: nga ni dpal chen sogs/ ta ya phaṭaḥ gegs sel 'don na/ hūm̐: rgyal pho gdon rgyal po sogs dang*/ nyin dang po lhan thabs las bla mas bden brjod bya/ mchan/ hūm̐ bzhi dang drag sngags srung gur/ hūm̐ hrīḥ rang nyid thugs las sogs/ bhūm̐: dang po'i nyin lhan thabs las srung dmigs dang rtenasnying bkra shis bya/ mchan/ mtshams sbyar las/ rang gi snying sogs/ spro na bder snying byin 'bebs byin brlabs char 'bebs bya/ mchan/ rang gzhung byin 'bebs/ hūm̐ hrīḥ mi gnas chos sku'i sogs nas/ lha bskyed kyi/ rol par smin: bar dngas/ dbang bskur rgyas ba/ mtshams sbyar las/ 465)rang gi snying ga'i sogs/ staṃ: bsdu na rang gzhung bar dang*/ spyan 'dren/ hūm̐ hrīḥ chos dbyings 'gyur med sogs nas/ khā hiḥ sman mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: chos sku kun bzang sogs/ siddhi hūm̐: bstod pa/ hūm̐ hrīḥ chos dbyings sogs/ āḥ 'dzab bskul gsol 'debs las/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: gdod ma'i mgon po sogs/

shog: bder snying las/ dzab khang dbye ba bya/ 'dzab dngos/ hūm̐: gtso bo'i thugs kar sogs/ yongs 'dus bsam: bsnyen pa ci 'grub dang*/ sngags phreng sogs/ chen por sangs: gong gi bsnyen pa bzla/ slar yang sngags sogs/ chen por āḥ gong gi dzaḥhūm̐ āḥcan gyi sgrub sngags bzla/ spro na bder snying las/ bdag dang mdun bskyed sogs/ ki la rigs bzhi'i snying po nyer snga/ rang nyid lhar gsal sogs/ khro bcu'i sngags bcu/ sgo bzhi'i sngags bdun/ slar yang 'od sogs/ mchan/ oṃ badzra sogs/ ki la ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥsogs/ dril sgrub sngags nyer lnga brjod/ nyin gnyis par zor la gzi byin bskyed pa/ hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs/ stsol: mchan/ bdag mdun rdo rje sogs/ bsam: oṃ badzra kī la sogs/ phaṭaḥ las sbyor sngags bzla/ las sbyor sngags bzla/ spu gri'i sngags nyer lnga dang*/ nyin gnyis par rten snying bcas zor la nas 'thor/ gzi byin bskyed pa'i 'jug gi lag tu thogs sogs/ bsam: mchan/ mtshams sbyar 466)las/ shāntiṃ puṣṭiṃ sogs/ gyur cig: dbyangs gsal gsum/ yig brgya gsum/ sten snying gsum/ hoḥ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor gyi sogs/ gsol: hūm̐ hrīḥ keṃ las rin chen sogs/ khā hiḥ hūm̐ hrīḥ chos dbyings sogs/ shwa lo ka gcig dngas/ dpal chen yab yum sogs bkod/ dge ba 'di yis sogs/ gsol kha bder snying ltar na lhan thabs las/ gtor snod e las sogs/ gyur: na mo: dkon mchog gsum sogs/ cig: lan gsum/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbyings nas thun mtshon sogs/ cig: yang na mtshams sbyar las/ e las gnam lcags sogs/ rgyur: na mo: rje btsun sogs/ khug cig lan gsum/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gong gi oṃ swa bha wa sogs/ stong pa nyid sogs/ cig: mchan/ sngags drug phyag drug mthar/ na mo: bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs sogs/ 'byung gyur cig: bka' srung gnyag po'i bskang gsol las/ sngon tshe spyi dpal sogs/ thugs dam bskangs:

nam mkha' mdzod sngags mthar/ bskang gsol bsdus pa/ dzaḥ dam tshig chen po'i sogs/ phrin las mdzo: lan gsum/ rang gzhung gi srung ma'i gsol ka bsdus pa/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hrīḥdzaḥ dad pa dang ni sogs/sa sa ma yaḥ lan bzhi/ bskang gsol las/ dzaḥ phur pa'i srung ma sogs/ 467) sa ma yaḥ de nas shan pa/ lha chen/ gza'/ bsnyan srung spyi'i gsol bsdus/ dregs pa rnam gsum/ sde mchod che chung*/ za du/ 'dod gsol/ phrin bcol sogs nas/ sngon tshe o rgyan sogs/ gang zhig yid la sogs/ bstan pa'i dpal gyur sogs/ bla ma rig 'dzin rgyal ba sogs/ dzaḥ ye shes 'od zer las/ rang gi mdun gyi sogs/ gsol: yig brgya/ rdzas bskang la/ hūm̐: snang ba snod kyi sogs/ mtshams rnams su yig brgya tshar re 'don par bya/ hoḥ nyan thos rang rgyal sogs/ shog: tshogs bsdus bcu sogs skabs dang bstun/ bskang ba'i lung byang las/ hoḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs/ stsol: sa twa ci 'grub/ dam tshig nyams chags sogs/ nam mkha'i mthar thug sogs/ tshogs mchod ye shes sprin phung las/sa hrīḥ rang nyid lha sogs/ tshogs phud mjug gi pūtstsha la khā hiḥ bskang ba shel gyi me long las/ oṃ: snang ba'i dngos po sogs/ dngos grub stsol: tshogs mchod la/ bshags pa/ hoḥ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs sogs/ āḥ mtshams sbyar las/ gtor snod gru gsum sogs/ dmigs: na mo: dkon mchog gsum dang sogs/ cigaḥ lan gsum/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bsgral ba/ hūm̐: srid pa e yi sogs/ rbad sod: drag sngags so lnga/ bstab pa ni/ hūm̐: bdag rtog gnyis sogs/ hi: 468)gnam phud/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: ye shes dbyings dang sogs/ sa ma dzaḥ drang ba ni/ hoḥ rdo rje phung po'i sogs/ siddhi hūm̐: mtsho dbus ge sar sogs/ o rgyan rin po che la sogs/ hrīḥ dkon mchog rtsa gsum sogs/ skyabs gnas bslu med sogs/ mtshams sbyar/ a mṛ ta sogs/ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong par sogs/ hāḥ lhag ma/ pheṃ bhyo: sngon tshe dpal chen sogs/

khā hiḥ rdo rje gzhon nu'i sogs/ tshogs mchod phul ba'i sogs/ mtshams sbyar la/ e las gnam lcags kyi sogs/ gyur: na mo: rje btsun sogs/ cig: lan gsum/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bskul ba ni/ hūm̐ bhyo: bzhengs shig rdo rje phur sogs/ sa ma ya: mtshams sbyar/ bdag mdun gyi sku las sogs/ ha ho hrīḥ chad tho ni/ hūm̐ bhyo: sngon tshe sogs/ mdzod: mtshams sbyar las/ bshal chu'i gtor ma sogs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: gsum/ bstan ma/ ma bhyo: dpal chen che mchog sogs/ khā hiḥ mtshams sbyar/ na mo: sangs rgyas kyi sogs/ cig: gsum mam gcig dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnod byed de dag sogs/ bsam: bro mnan/ hūm̐: dpal chen gsang ba'i sogs/ nan: mtshams sbyar las/ gtor snod kha yar sogs/ swā hā: bdag mdun gyi thugs las sogs/ bsam: hoḥ dngos su 'byor dang sogs/ mchod: oṃ shri badzra ku mā ra sa pa ri wā ra badzra arghaṃ sogs/ shabda rū pa sogs/ 469)dharma pa tītstsha ye swā hāḥ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha hiḥ ma hā rakta= ma hā ba liṃ ta sogs/ mtshams sbyar las/ sprul pa'i lha mo sogs/ bsal: hūm̐ hrī: ma bcos spros bral sogs/ hūm̐: mi bsrun rngam pa sogs/ bka' brgyud bla ma sogs/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa sogs/ bstod par 'os pa sogs/ mtshams sbyar las/ lha mo rnams sogs/ gyur: bshags pa ni/ ho: dpal chen dkyil 'khor sogs/ stsol: oṃ sa ma ya: sogs yig brgya lan gsum/ bsngo smon ni/ hoḥ bdag gi dus gsum sogs/ lan gsum/ oṃ/ 'dir ni rten dang sogs/ swā hā: nyin tha mar/ oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can sogs/ badzra mum̐ḥgyis mdun bskyed ye shes sems dpa' dbyings su gshegs/ bsdu ldang ni/ hūm̐: thabs kyis bskyed pa'i sems sogs/ āḥ mtshams sbyar las/ rang gi thugs ka'i sogs/ gyur: oṃ ye dharmā sogs/ bkra shis ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ mnyam nyid gdod nas sogs/ bkra shis shog: bstan pa'i dpal gyur sogs/ gnas 'dir nyin mo sogs/sa gyur cig lhan thabs las/sa

na mo/ dkon mchog gsum gyi sogs/ sangs rgyas bstan pa sogs/ kun bzang rdo rje sogs/ na mo gu ru/ bdag gzhan rnams kyi sogs/ mtha' brgyan par bya'o// ༈ 470)nyin gnyis pa smad las dgra bgegs bsgral ba la/ stod kyi las rim rnams ni dmigs bsal yod pa ma gtogs nyin dang po ltar yin/ lhag ma'i mjug tu/ lhan thabs las/ gtor snod e las sogs/ gyuraḥ na mo: dkon mchog sogs/ cigaḥ lan gsum/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbyings nas sogs/ par gyur: drag bskul me phreng gi hūm̐ bhyo: mthing nag gru gsum sogs/ sa ma ya: drag bsgrub cha lag las/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ gser skyems gtor ma zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo sogs/ phrin las mdzod: drag sgrub zab mo las/ rtsa sngags dang*/ bdag gi lhar gsal ba'i sogs/ thim par gyur: na mo: drin chen rtsa ba sogs/ dzaḥ lan dgu re'i mtshams su spu gri'i sngags mthar/ gnod byed dgra bgegs sogs/ baṃ hoḥ de ltar gzhan yang 'gugs pa che chung brgya rtsa sogs mthar/ spro na rtsa sngags mthar/ gnod byed dgra bgegs rnams kyi bla sha sogs/ baṃ hoḥ lan dgu brjod/ mchan/ de nas bcing pa'i las ni/ hūm̐ bhyo: dpal chen rdo rje sogs/ pa shaṃ hūm̐: dmigs rim ni/ bdag mdun gyi sku las sogs/ bsam: de'i 'gres kyis lha dbye dang*/ smyor gzhug gnyis 471)dmigs rim bcas 'don mthar/ phur bskyed ni/ bdag nyid dpal chen sogs/ a ā phaṭaḥ gdab las phur thun thogs nas/ hūm̐ bhyo: nga ni dpal chen sogs/ shig: oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya ma rakmo yakmo sogs/ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ sdang byed dgra dang sogs/ phob dzaḥ de'i 'gres bzhin yungs thun phrag mtsho dug mtshon mda' rdo gtor thun mjug tu/ gtun brdung ni/ hūm̐ bhyo: khro rgyal dpal chen sogs/ sod sod: drag sngags so lngas bsgral/ zhal bstab ni/ hūm̐ bhyo: dpal chen rdo rje sogs/

khā hiḥ bstod pa/ hūm̐: mi srun rngam sogs/ bstod: sri mnan dang sbyin sreg sogs byed na 'don/ drag bzlog las/ hūm̐ bhyo: mthing nag e las sogs/ bhyo bhyo bzlog bzlog: bder snying las/ rtsang bskyed/ bdag mdun gnyis kyi sogs/ nan phaṭaḥ bden pa'i stobs bzlog las/ na mo: dkon mchog gsum dang sogs/ cig: lan gsum/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub sogs/ nus ldan thogs med las/ na mo: gson cig dgongs shig sogs nas/ bzlog: mtshams sbyar las/ e las gnam lcags sogs nas bskul ba chad bstan man chad nyin dang po ltar ro/ ༈ nyin tha ma la/ bden pa'i stobs bzlog mjug tu/ bder snying 472)gi nang sgo dbye ba las/ oṃ a ka ro sogs/ dzaḥ rdo rje rigs kyi sogs/ yongs grub mdzod: rtsa gsum spyi gces dngos grub len chog hūm̐ hrīḥ ka dag sogs/ dza dzaḥ ye shes dbab pa'i sogs/ bsam la: rtsa sngags mthar/ kā ya siddhi sogs/ hrīḥ brgya rtsa'am nyer gcig sogs bzlas mthar/ dngos grub/ hoḥ chos nyid 'gyur sogs/ hrīḥ tshogs mchod las/ dngos grub/ hūm̐: spros bral 'dus ma sogs/ siddhi hrīḥ dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams blangs/ phyi sgor byon te/ phyi'i sgo dbye rdo rje'i bka' nyan las/ a ka ro dang nam mkha' mdzod kyis brlabs te/ kyai: srid pa shar sogs/ swā hā: nus thogs las/ na mo: gson cig sogs/ bzlog bzlog: nang du 'byor la/ mchod bstod bsdus pa dang*/ yig brgya/ gtor ma'i ye shes pa sogs/ brlag par bsam: spu gri lan bdun dang*/ drag sngags so lnga char gcig rten snying bcas bzlog gtor dang thun zor rnams nus ldan du brlabs/ mtshams sbyar las/ e las gnam lcags sogs/ gyur: na mo: rje btsun sogs/ khug cigaḥ lan gsum/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bskul ba las/ hūm̐ bhyo: bzhengs shig rdo rje sogs/ sa ma ya: mtshams sbyar las/ na mo: rje btsun sogs/ cig: lan gsum/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bdag mdun gyi sku las sogs/

ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum/ 473)chad tho/ hūm̐ bhyo: sngon tshe sogs/ phrin las mdzod: gtor zor gdab pa ni/ hūm̐ bhyo: gson cig dgongs sogs/ phob dzaḥ gtor ma drag po'i sogs/ bsam mo: spro na dmod ngan rdo rje thog mda' 'don/ mchan/ mtshams sbyar las/ bshal chu'i gtor ma sogs/ brtan ma/ ma bhyo: dpal chen sogs/ khā hi: sri mnan gyi lhan 'dir bya/ mchan/ mtshams sbyar las/ na moḥ sangs rgyas kyi sogs/ cig: lan gsum/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnod byed de dag sogs/ bsam: bro mnan/sa hū: dpal chen gsang ba'i sogs/ nan: mtshams sbyar las/ gtor snod kha yar sogs/ hā/ gsol ba mchod/ tshe 'gugs bkra shis bcas brjod mthar/ mtshams sbyar/ bdag mdun gyi sogs/ mchod bstod bshags smon gshegs gsol bsdu rim bkra shis bsngo smon sogs mtha' rgyas su bya'o/ de yang gter gzhung rtsa ba las/ gnas min gsum gyi yul du gsang ba gnad/ chos sgrub rnams kyi bar chad sel ba dang bstan gzhi dge 'dun dar ba sogs las/ grong chog rnyed tshol sogs kyi phyir du gsang sgo mi 'chol pa gnad dam pa'o// ces pa 'di nyid rdo rje'i lung zin dam pa karma don yod nas 'di lta bu'i 'don 'grigs khyer bde zhig dgos zhes bskul ma nan cher mdzad pa'i zhal ma ldog par skyabs rje mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo 474)mchog nas nyid nas gtan dbab ma mdzad rigs/ gter chen yab sras gzhung nas zhal gsab chog cing phyag bzhes kun tu de ltar byed chog par bkas gnang ba thob cing nyid kyi zhal rgyun rnams gzhir byas nas slob 'bangs gyi na ba tshul khrims rdo rjes phur ba bde gshegs snying po'i 'don 'grigs ltar du bris pa'o// dge'o// ༄༅/ de nas sri mnan la/ smad las mjug tu rdo rje lhun po las/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: gser skyems gtor ma zag pa med pa sogs/ gyur: kyai: skyabs gnas sogs/ phrin las mdzod: na mo: dkon mchog sogs/ lan gsum/ hūm̐ dzaḥ phyogs bcu dus gsum sogs/

bsam: 'gugs pa sdeb shar/ na mo: drin chen sogs/ khyad par du bdag cag dpon slob sogs/ baṃ hoḥ lan dgu/ 'gugs thung*/ na mo: dkon mchog gsum sogs/ baṃ hoḥ nyer lnga/ gzhan yang*/ hūm̐ bhyo: bde gshegs rgyal ba sogs/ a āḥ bco lnga/ rdor lhun las/ hūm̐: rtsa gsum sogs/ mdzod cigaḥ rtsa sngags mthar/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sogs/ baṃ hoḥ bla'i gugs lan dgu/ dza dza: thams cad sogs/ med par gyur: rtsa sngags mthar/ sarba tri dzaḥsogs/ bhyo phaṭaḥ nyer gcig brjod/ rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i sogs/ bsam: 'gugs gzhug gsum mthar/ hūm̐: rtsa gsum dam can sogs/ ma ya: 475) gzhung gi bro mnan bya'o/ ༈ nyin tha ma la/ smad las mjug tu/ rang nyid rdo rje gzhon nu'i sogs/ ru pa la bstim: na mo: drin chen rtsa ba sogs/ 'guugs chen gcig gri 'gugs 'bring po gsum/ chung ba lnga/ bla 'gugs sngags gsum mthar/ rdor lhun las/ oṃ tsakra sogs/ med par gyur: rtsa sngags/ sarba tri dzaḥsogs/ lan bdun gyi tshe ling ga thod par bcug rang nyid lhar gsal pa'i sogs/ sa ma ya: hūm̐ḥ rang bzhin rnam dag sogs/ mnan: rdzogs pa'i byang chub sogs/ ༈ nyin tha mar mnan pa la/ bstan ma'i mjug tu/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ḥ gser skyems zag pa med pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ rdor lhun las/ kyai: skyabs gnas sogs/ grub par mdzod: ( 'og gi sa gshags/ ? ) hūm̐: rang nyid drag po sogs/ st+waṃ: 'gugs gzhug mthar gsum/ sha ri khrag gi sogs/ grub par mdzod: gong gi e bskyed/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs nas sngar bzhin la/ sri mnan nyer gcig mthar/ 'og gi dzaḥ phung sri sogs/ btab par bsamaḥ hūm̐: zhing bcu sogs/ dgongs rgyas thobaḥ mtshams rnams su gong gi sarba tri dzaḥsogs tshar te gdon/ hūm̐: ma hā ba la sogs/ ma ra ya nan nan: mtshams sbyar las/ na mo: sangs rgyas kyi sogs nas/ gzhung gi bro mnan bya'o// 476)
